senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כָּבַס)to press, squeeze. Ohol. VIII, 5 כ׳ את האבן וכ׳ if one pressed a stone on (weighted) the sheet.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 23b:4">Bets. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>שהיא כּוֹבֶשֶׁת</he> because it (the wagon) presses (the ground) down.
Sabb. XX, 5 לא כוֹבְשִׁין you must not screw down, v. מַכְבֵּשׁ; a. fr.—Part. pass. כָּבוּשׁ, f. כְּבוּשָׁה pressed, compressed; pressing.

<cite ref="Shabbat 135a">Ib. 135ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:9">Tosef. ib. XV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:9">XVI</cite>), 9; a. e. <he>ערלה כ׳ היא</he> the foreskin (which seems to be wanting) is pressed (to the membrum).
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 9:4">Tosef. Ohol. IX, 4</cite> <he>כאילו אבנים כְּבוּשׁוֹת וכ׳</he> as if stones were placed tightly upon them.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:22">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>ההר … כְּבוּשִׁין על וכ׳</he> a mountain on each side pressing upon (preventing the run of) the springs; a. fr.

senses.gloss: כ׳ פנים (בקרקע) to press the face into the ground, to hide one’s self in fear or shame.
units: Snh. 19ᵇ כָּבְשׁוּ פניהם בקרקע they cast their looks down (were afraid to give an opinion). Y. ib. X, 27ᵈ (ref. to Is. VII, 3) א״ת כובס אלא כּוֹבֵשׁ שהיה כובש פניו וכ׳ read not kobes, but kobesh, for he hid his face and fled before him; (Bab. ib. 104ᵃ דכבשינהו לאפי Chald.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 2:1">Toh. II, 1</cite> <he>האשה … כּוֹבֶשֶׁת וכ׳</he> if a woman was pressing vegetables in a pot.
Ukts. II, 1 זתים שכְּבָשָׁן וכ׳ olives which one pressed with their leaves; a. fr.—Part. pass. כָּבוּשׁ preserved substance, pickle.
<cite ref="Chullin 97b:4">Ḥull. 97ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כ׳ הרי הוא כמבושל</he> preserved substances are in ritual law like cooked.—Pl. <he>כְּבוּשִׁין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 2:6">Pes. II, 6</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:4:5">Y. Sabb. I, 3ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>כְּבוּשֵׁיהֶן</he> preserves made by gentiles; a. fr.
Ḥag. 13ᵃ (ref. to Prov. XXVII, 26) א״ת כבשים אלא כְּבוּשִׁים Ms. M. (missing in ed.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) read not K’basim (sheep) but K’bushim (hidden things), v. כִּבְשָׁן; Yalk. Prov. 961.—

<cite ref="Sotah 10b:6">Sot. 10ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Makkot 23b:5-12">Macc. 23ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 38:25">Gen. XXXVIII, 25</cite>) <he>יצאת … ממני יצאו כבושים</he> a divine voice went forth and said, ‘from me went forth the secret things’ (I declare that Judah is the father of Tamar’s children; Ar.: <he>ממני היו הדברים כ׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 145:9">Yalk. Gen. 145</cite>; Yalk.Sam. 112.

senses.gloss: to detain (cmp. עצר). Pesik. Bayom, p. 193ᵇ; כָּבְשָׁה אותם מטרונא וכ׳ the matron detained them one day longer; כבשה אותן התורה וכ׳ the Law detained them one day longer (before the Lord); ib. 195ᵃ, sq.; Pesik. R. suppl., s. 4.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8">Gen. R. s. 8</cite>, end <he>האיש כּוֹבֵשׁ וכ׳</he> the man detains his wife from going out; a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:5">Snh. XI, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 89a:8">89ᵃ</cite>) <he>הכּוֹבֵש את נבואתו</he> (a prophet) who suppresses his prophecy (being afraid to proclaim it).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:1">Ab. IV, 1</cite> <he>הכיבש את יצרו</he> who conquers his passion.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 5:1">Lam. R. to V, 1</cite> <he>כובש את הגדול</he> (not <he>כביש</he>), v. <cite ref="G00691"><he>זַרְזִיר</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 5:1:6">Y. Succ. V, 55ᵇ</cite> top <he>עד שאתה מְכַבֵּשׁ … בוא וכְבוֹש וכ׳</he> instead of conquering the barbarians, come and subdue the Jews; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 16</cite>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:19">ib. to IV, 19</cite>.

Ex. R. s. 25 הוא כוֹבְשׁוֹ וכ׳ he suppresses (withholds the evidence) and does not produce it.—כ׳ עון to suppress guilt, to forgive, cause forgiveness. Pesik. Eth Korb., p. 61ᵇ; Pesik. R. s. 16, v. כֶּבֶשׁ; a. fr.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 10:9">Esth. R. to VII, 7</cite> [read:] <he>הרי הוא כּוֹבְשֵׁנִי וכ׳</he> behold, he is attacking me in thy presence.

senses.gloss: to pave, grade a road.—Part. pass. כָּבוּשׁ, f. כְּבוּשָׁה. Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 20 דרך כ׳ a graded road; ib. ed. Bub. 47; Yalk. Num. 764. [Pirké d’R. El. ch. LII כובשים במזלות, read with Yalk. Josh. 22: חושבים; Yalk. Gen. 77 רוגשים.]

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 6:17">Tosef. Mikv. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 7:17">VII</cite>), 17 <he>לכלוכי צואה … המ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>והמכושים</he>, corr. acc.) secretory substances … which are compressed, i.e. dried up by being sat upon.

senses.gloss: (cmp. סָלַל II) to press down, make even, grade.
units: Bets. IV, 5 מְכַבְּשִׁין you may press the ashes down (make a graded surface for baking); a. e.—Trnsf. to level, make plain.

Cant. R. to I, 2 (play on כבשים, Prov. XXVIII, 26, v. כֶּבֶשׁ) … כְּבָשִׁים … תהי׳ מְכַבֵּשׁ לפניהם וכ׳ it may be read K’bashim (grades), as long as thy pupils are young, make the words of the Law plain before them; when they are older reveal to them the secrets (reasons) of the Law; Yalk. ib. 985 הֱיֵה כוֹבֵשׁ לפניהם (another expl., v. infra).—כ׳ את הריחיים [to carve steps for the grain,] to put the millstones in working order.
<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:9">M. Kat. I, 9</cite>; expl.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 10a">ib. 10ᵃ</cite> to sharpen the millstones (v. <cite ref="N01241"><he>נָקַר</he> I</cite>), (oth. opin.) to cut the hole out for the hopper.

senses.gloss: (interch. with Kal) to conquer, defeat. Y. Peah VII, 20ᶜ top שבע שכִּיבְּשׁוּ seven years during which they were engaged in conquering the land; Ḥull. 17ᵃ שכבשו.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 51:2">Sifré Deut. 51</cite> <he>לכַבֵּש ח״ל עד שלא יְכַבְּשׁוּ וכ׳</he> to conquer foreign land before they shall have conquered Palestine.
<cite ref="Pesachim 5b">Pes. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>נכרי שכִּיבַּשְׁתּוֹ</he> a gentile who is in thy power.

<cite ref="Yevamot 65b:4">Yeb. 65ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>וכבשה</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 1:28">Gen. I, 28</cite>) <he>איש דרכו לכַבֵּשׁ וכ׳</he> it is man who conquers (the earth) but not woman; <cite ref="Kiddushin 35a">Kidd. 35ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to suppress, withhold. Cant. R. l. c. תהי׳ מכבש לפניהם וכ׳ withhold from them, i.e. teach them merely the words of the Law without arguments; (another expl., v. supra).

units: Tosef. Sot. VI, 6 מכבש את הגנות וכ׳ climbing over the garden fences and violating the women; Gen. R. s. 53; Yalk. Gen. 94 מַכְבִּישׁ Hif.

senses.gloss: to be pressed down, suppressed. Pesik. Eth. Korb. p. 61ᵇ כל דבר שהוא נ׳ סופו לצוף whatever is pressed down, is liable to come to the surface again; Pesik. R. s. 16.

units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 30">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXX</cite>, end when scholars sit down <he>ונִכְבָּשִׁין אלו לאלו</he> and are submissive (respectful) to one another; (<cite ref="Shabbat 63a:19">Sabb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>ונוחין</he>).

senses.gloss: to have surreptitious intercourse. Sifra Emor, Par. 6, ch. V נ׳ עם; Yeb. VII, 5 נ׳ על.

to be conquered, be taken. Y. Shebi. VI, 36ᶜ bot. כמי שנִתְכַּבְּשׁוּ they are to be treated as if they had been subdued (in the days of Joshua). Ib. שמא נִתְכַּבְּשָׁה מד״ת perhaps it was to be taken by the command of the Law; Y. Yeb. VII, 8ᵃ bot. (corr. acc.).
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 18:7">Ex. R. s. 18</cite> <he>עכשיו … מִתְכַּבֶּשֶׁת בידו</he> just now Jerusalem may be taken by him (Sennacherib). [Pesik. Zutr., Ekeb, ed. Bub. p. 30 <he>מתכבשים</he>, <he>מתכבשות</he>, v. <cite ref="K01391"><he>כָּתַשׁ</he></cite>.]
